Ilse, I didn't record 25 November as the renewal date, because our records say otherwise. I replied in your #north-team thread to point this out.

- The signed 2025–2026 renewal order form for Brackenwater Freight Co., signed 21 Nov 2025, sets the renewal date (end of the current term) as 30 November 2026.
- The account notes from 30 Sep and Dana's handover email to you and Marcus also say 30 November.
- A CRM note from 10 Feb says 31 December 2026, which doesn't match either date.

In the thread I asked whether 25 November is a newly agreed change or the date you want it signed by. If it's a real change, Marcus (account owner) and June (deal desk) should confirm it so the records can be updated. Until then I'm using 30 November.

I left out all prices and discounts, since only dates came up.
